form.label: Scripts & agent activity
form.description: Correlate requested executions, Zabbix command operations, and agent-side evidence.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: Correlate requested executions, Zabbix command operations, and agent-side evidence.

html.p: Agent records use host identity and are not filtered by the API instance selector. Enable LogRemoteCommands (agent) or Plugins.SystemRun.LogRemoteCommands (agent 2), then forward their logs. UserParameter/plugin child processes also require OS process auditing for complete execution coverage.

search.query: `zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:audit action=execute | dedup event_uid | spath input=_raw path=raw.details output=details | table _time instance user src resource resource_name recordsetid details
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:alerts raw.alerttype=1 | dedup event_uid | table _time instance eventid alertid status raw.actionid raw.esc_step raw.retries
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:execution | stats latest(status) AS status min(_time) AS started by instance user scriptid hostid request_id | convert ctime(started)
`zabbix_events` (sourcetype=zabbix:agent OR sourcetype=zabbix:agent2 OR sourcetype=zabbix:server) command=* | table _time host source command | sort -_time
